title: Probability-weighted complex mean
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, let $p$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega$, and let $f:\Omega\to\mathbb{C}$. The $p$-weighted complex mean of $f$ is $\sum_{x\in\Omega}p(x)f(x)$.
